You get one free spin every day, and after that, you can continue spinning using ZP collected in-game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/1f8a5bf45f67fe47833da7cea44e303246cac12b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]ELITE WHEEL SERIES AND GLOVES[/p][p]The new Elite Wheel Series and Gloves, giving the season its name, are now in Zula![/p][p]AK47 | RSS | MPT76 | AWP | KAR98 | AUGSNP[/p][p]M93R | KARAMBIT | DOUBLE BOMB[/p][p]Gloves designed specifically for the Elite Wheel series are available for all characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/5e2ec64fa7917d25ca4e1222a46033ed2632d8a5.png"][/img][/p][p]STICKER HEROIC SERIES AND GLOVES[/p][p]The Sticker (Heroic) series is now available for the following weapons:[/p][p]AK-47 | M468 | MPT76 | AWP | KAR98[/p][p]AUGSNP | L115A3 | DEAGLE | RAZOR | TRP90[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/02ead369aeeaf9244000c05fa9396961e3a3a098.png"][/img][/p][p]SPRAYS[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/e30ad2612f7d49021122e8e8d8b653f2f5d9a8f5.png"][/img][/p][p]CLAN LOGOS[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/125b7b85802e8b7a877e81a9447cda2ffdd21727.png"][/img][/p][p]OTHER FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/p][p]Fixed the bug where weapon pose reset constantly when switching between attachment tabs in the Customize screen.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where scopes didn’t appear on sniper weapon panels in the Market.[/p][p]Fixed crashes in Battle Royale mode.[/p]

1. Eşref’s Hour SEASON

Eşref Alpan, under the watchful eye of Uncle Eşref since the orphanage days, had been working within the mafia on behalf of Zula. But everything fell apart when he discovered that his childhood love, Hayal, was actually a Gladio agent. He officially joined Zula. Will Eşref be able to take revenge on both his great love Hayal and Gladio?

Are You Ready for the Eşref’s Hour Season?
Complete missions in the Eşref’s Hour season, collect stars, and unlock the latest skins!

7.CHARACTERS: EŞREF ALPAN & HAYAL VESPERA

Eşref Alpan:
Abandoned as a baby and raised in an orphanage, Eşref was visited regularly by Uncle Eşref from the age of three. Guided by him, he entered the mafia at age 18. Brave, fearless, and calm, he always followed his namesake’s words. He was preparing to marry Hayal, whom he met at the orphanage, but discovered she was a Gladio agent sent to get close to him. After being exposed, he left the mafia and joined Team Zula.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/39c9d0c22b26306101891fb9648419393db67ed5.png[/img]
Hayal Vespera:
Raised as a Gladio agent from a young age, Hayal was assigned to infiltrate Eşref’s life from the orphanage. Cold-blooded, stubborn, and dangerous, she never questioned her mission—until she began to develop real feelings for Eşref. After her identity was exposed, Eşref left her, but Gladio took her back. Now she suppresses her emotions and carries out even more ruthless missions.

notes.title: v1.74 Update is Live!
notes.content:
v1.74 Update is Live!
1. “Open Again” Button for Cases, Decks, and Material Packs
With this improvement, players can now open multiple cases, decks, and material packs in one go—without leaving the screen, depending on how many of each item they have in their inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/d270b1a9065d696db489445cc4572d37d494e82b.jpg[/img]
2. Quick Revive Item for BR Mode
In Battle Royale Mode, you no longer have to wait while reviving a teammate. Thanks to the Quick Revive item, you can instantly bring your teammate back on their feet.

3. Faster and Smoke-Free Air Supply with ZIHA
Now you can call in an air supply in just 20 seconds using ZIHA—without any smoke!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/2b8ee86bfb028104f2934b8cb81a8aa376af26c2.png[/img]
4. Win Streak Feature
In Ranked Mode, you can now see your number of consecutive wins without losing. Plus, a new system has been added that allows you to compensate for losses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a6f1d1a0105a71e58137d055fa2517f60267d488.png[/img]

5. 4th and 5th Character Booster Slots Activated and Displayed
The 4th and 5th booster slots are now available—exclusively for XP and ZP boosters. Also, all booster slots are now visible on the customization page.

6. The Breeze Blade is in Zula!
Ready to defeat your opponents with the power of the wind? Inspired by a fan and featuring iconic animations, the Breeze Blade has arrived in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/14cf48517b48aeb0bebcd534aa8c9a422f9dc093.png[/img]

7. New Meta Weapon: ATAK
The new meta assault rifle, ATAK, is now available in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a18d0fb3ded73c12318113e88d1b1b3071394d3c.png[/img]

8. Skins and Series for AUG A3S, ATAK, and Breeze Weapons
New skins and series are available for the AUG A3S, ATAK, and Breeze-themed weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/fc39f1d3fb752501588b060ddd333581a86c467c.png[/img]

9. Lucky Fish Series: Red, Blue, and Yellow Editions
The beloved Lucky Fish Series returns—now in vibrant Red, Blue, and Yellow colors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/41afc3353ab96cf26bd66193ced4f593f7c62317.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/889c1c75ea67cb4dfdb51db3c02dbe07e40ebfa8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/51eb8108f276788264cd9a059a59b77fdd0714ba.png[/img]

10. Level-Up Pop-Up UI Update
The level-up and reward pop-up UI has been refreshed with updated visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/8726804abf68ef118accfc22a227ff13b0eb5b22.jpg[/img]
11. Clan Logos
New customizable Clan Logos have been added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/ccc1767e83fa1f7d6260c8c9fc8700689660d55c.png[/img]
12. Sprays
New sprays are now available in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/f7e700fba8dd7a7ec14fca61a6040f65e432768b.png[/img]
13. BR Mode-Specific Movement Speed Boosters (+7% – +10%)
New +7% and +10% Movement Speed Boosters are now available for all characters in Battle Royale mode. Reach your targets faster than ever!

14. New Map, Weapon, Deck, and Case Badges
New badges have been added to the game to honor your achievements in maps, weapons, decks, and cases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/4f14a40a3b7b4184a5f2f26dcbb577d2af4672f9.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.73 UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
V1.73 UPDATE IS LIVE!

1- DEEP OPERATION
Demir Erez and his team launch a covert operation to stop Gladyo's recent activities. However, with its strategic advantage, Gladyo gains the upper hand, pushing the Zula team to the brink of despair. Just when everything seems lost, the Zula team unveils its secret weapon, turning the tide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/13a4120500aa13064aaadbe502daaa47036fa013.png[/img]


2- BATTLE ROYALE PASS IS NOW IN ZULA!
A seasonal reward system where you can level up by earning Battle Royale Stars through daily missions, weekly contracts, and seasonal achievements. Progress through 70 levels and unlock exclusive Battle Royale rewards, including in-game valuable items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/f05977b7a494522dbb9433150dc6402c8e1e0748.png[/img]

3- VIP EXCLUSIVE: VOTE TO KICK FEATURE IN ZULA!
A new feature has been added, allowing VIP players to start a vote to remove a player in Competitive and Fast Lobby TDM mode.

[b]Version 1.57 Released![/b]

We continue to improve Zula with a new update every month and add new content!

1.NEW CLAN SYSTEM AND MATCH END SCREEN RENEWAL
With this newly developed system, players will earn clan experience points to contribute to their clans, regardless of which game mode they prefer. Additionally, they will be able to see the clan experience points they have earned on the redesigned match end screen.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/20477cfe439d05c97656eb8e387c0607ba6309b5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/42ad9becfd53959857a76b71baac882163fac34d.png[/img][/url]

Default fire rate reduced from 735 to 705.
Fire rate reduced from 764 to 740 at +4. (Up to +7, 740)
Damage reduced from 37 to 36 at +5. (Up to +7, 36)
Reload time increased from 34 to 36 at +6. (Up to +7, 36)

Damage increased from 33 to 38 at +5. (Up to +7, 38)
** As the weapon has been upgraded to a higher tier, material values, upgrade success rate, and transfer amount have been updated.

Effective range increased from 63 to 66 at default. (Up to +7, 66)
Reload time reduced from 38 to 36 at +3. (Up to +7, 36)

Default fire rate reduced from 930 to 900.
Fire rate reduced from 1004 to 963 at +4. (Up to +7, 963)

P90

Default fire rate increased from 875 to 900.
Fire rate increased from 918 to 972 at +4. (Up to +7, 972)
Damage increased from 28 to 31 at +5. (Up to +7, 31)

Magazine capacity reduced from 7 to 5 at default.
Magazine capacity reduced from 10 to 7 at +1. (Up to +7, 7)
Movement speed reduced from 84 to 82 at +6.
Movement speed reduced from 87 to 84 at +7.

Zoom opening speed increased by 12.5% at +7. (Previously 17%)

Omar Rabi was a treasure hunter born in the ancient Egyptian lands, pursuing the secrets hidden under the historical sands.
The history of the land he lived in began to attract him more and more every day. Despite his young age, Omar attracted attention with the knowledge and skills he acquired in treasure hunting. He was known not only for chasing legendary treasures, but also for his ability to solve these mysteries.

When Omar Rabi's story caught the attention of Larry, the leaders of the Gladio team, he was offered a special mission.
Gladio had a special weapon, imbued with ancient power and available only to legendary treasure hunters. Omar accepted this task and embarked on a difficult journey.

During the days spent in forgotten temples and ancient cemeteries in search of this weapon called ""Messenger"",
Omar Rabi was tested both physically and mentally. But overcoming every difficulty, he found the special weapon and managed to empower it with an ancient Egyptian spell.

The addition of this special weapon to the Gladio team showed that Omar was more than just a treasure hunter. His proficiency in close combat and the power of his special weapon made him one of Gladio's most valuable members.
When he joined the team, Omar Rabi became known as a new warrior, not only on the trail of legendary treasures, but also fighting against Zula.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/8336173b83ca5ac52d4c372938d3b511575e1138.jpg[/img]

V1.50 Improvement Pack Released!

In Zula, we have prepared a huge update package in this month's update to provide you with a better gaming experience.

[previewyoutube=dBLVfUJ3ZTs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]












- Season 37 ''Infestation''
The award-winning Season 37 ''Infestation'' has begun! Beautiful rewards await you in the award-winning Invasion Season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/48b81917e02fabc61e2b9b3a5dc0bd562244c1f8.png[/img]

- Bomb and Knife Decks
New Bomb and Knife skins are now in the game for you to reach Bomb and Knife Skins more easily.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/c3c9af75fae7746deec260189f9d7e48afbe1531.png[/img]

- New Custom Clan Logos
Our Private Clans are growing like an avalanche. New exclusive Clan Logos requested by our clans are now in play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/621649951965cea1ca9158370b75929db49e2327.png[/img]

- Oni Series and Gloves
Trust your friends, are you ready to strike fear into your opponents? The new ""Heroic"" Oni Series, blended with the design of Japanese culture, is now in play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/1c4b6e9ae56edb941d67e21fbf410fb203c6f3d3.png[/img]

- Infestation Series and Gloves
Are you ready to be the survivor in the invasion world? The new "Elite" Invasion series is now in play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/eaa0d130185dc2cfac90edb5e6ac72def4e864f3.png[/img]

- New Sprays Arrived
Fun new sprays have taken their place in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/621649951965cea1ca9158370b75929db49e2327.png[/img]

- New Knife Skin
New patterns for Butterfly, Exo, Karambit and Razor blades are now available
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/c68c70509c67d21e7c927d86a4d02a1e28032662.png[/img]

- New Gloves
New gloves, which are the favorite of both the season and the summer months, are in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/aab30cc924520688ae65c0342df529e6e795d8ea.png[/img]

- New Emoticons in game
You loved the expression system. We did not neglect to add new emoticons for you in this update. Added Crab, Eagle, Drop Mic, Exaggerated Clap, Selfie, and Sincanli Sitting emotes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/13acb9ec4bff83dc1851d826e9ba813f42897c10.png[/img]

- Healing Enhancements
As we said at the beginning, our improvements that will improve your gaming experience are as follows;
Your game will now launch faster. With the improvement, we shortened the game login times.
In-game interfaces have been optimized. Thanks to this work done for panels such as tab screen, settings screen, leaderboard, your gaming experience will be improved even more.
For our players using an external video card, an automatic switching system to the external video card has been added when logging into the game.
Optimization work was done to stabilize the FPS flow.
Fixed the issue of throwing in the game with the Clan Capacity Booster.
Bowie and Kukri unlocked for upgrade.
You will now be able to copy the invite address from within the game for your Social Missions.

notes.title: With the V1.49 update, Zula has been renewed, strengthened!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/395468eb47a6baf6ef4336c49ce5c9a5818fa11a.jpg[/img]

[b]With the V1.49 update, Zula has been renewed, strengthened![/b]

1- Mission System Update
Thanks to the new update, you will now be able to access all the information you need about the missions.
-The task button has been added to the menu with the new system. This button will take you directly to the quests screen in Zula Pass.
- When you open the score screen with the tab key in the game, you will be able to see the 3 closest tasks to the right. In addition, the task categories on the screen can be changed with the mouse scroll button.

You can now multiply rewards for each day you enter the game in Zula, and you can get bigger rewards when you log into the game regularly. You can also see what rewards you can win all month in the new Event System.

notes.title: V1.47 Update Notes
notes.content:
[b]V1.47 Update Notes[/b]

We are here with a giant update package that we prepared with full content in April!

1- Emote System
Matches are now more fun in Zula! With the newly developed fun emote system, players will now be able to dance or express themselves in the game. It will also play fun sound effects while using emoticons.
With this update, Clap, Apache dance, Backpack dance, Laughter, Uncrowned King pose, Robot dance, Worm dance and Surrender expressions have been added to the game.
Note: Expressions may vary from character to character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/75e0f0b9afb57787331d183efa5b79efd3f0ee8f.png[/img]

2- Leyla Kurt and Kiera Jelani are in the game!
In the war of Zula and Gladio, 2 new characters are now in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/fcbdb97c8dbb6bee9fe98f0f96a896c579b893a0.png[/img]

3- Toxic Smoke Bomb
The Toxic Smoke Bomb, which we are familiar with from the Battle Royale Mode, has been added to the game. Details about the Toxic Smoke Bomb are as follows;
Toxic Smoke Grenade inserts into the regular bomb slot.
It has an 8 second poisoning time.
Toxic Smoke Bomb, like other bombs, affects the person who throws it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b4a0d895d40e239a1715d7aa4d36fbe7d375a052.png[/img]

4- Junkyard Map
Junkyard map is now in Zula, where 10 players can play All Solo and TDM matches at the same time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/283785e137b355b22f86b49e25d4dfcc54c079fa.png[/img]

5- Green Crystal Series and Gloves
The new Heroic Green Crystal Line and Gloves have been added to the game with the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b660192fd071202f682d52d322db39fd24bb36d9.png[/img]

6- Silver Master Series and Gloves
The new Elite Silvermaster Series and Gloves are now available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/6c5a6817e43c72e4c02f37df8c19c488e65c21cd.png[/img]

7- Dual Grenade Skins Part 2
You loved the double bomb patterns! With the new update, 6 new Double Bomb patterns have been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/9f8edfa989eb5f711c1cfa7b71a63ac6bc2ad8d3.png[/img]

8- Knife Skins
Added 4 new patterns for Butterfly, Exo, Razor and Karambit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/52edc917a6aff1f6f1aba2394449bc4797daeaab.png[/img]

9- New Animated Gloves
New animated gloves for all characters have been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/1d90152a8a88f48c404119796fe5faa34d70ec32.png[/img]

10- New Sprays
Fun sprays with Rainlox pattern, our permanent content producer, are now in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/aebdaf82cdfb4fc23744a527fee96e9383134071.png[/img]

11- New Flag Skins
Zula's Globalization operation continues. Azerbaijan, Poland and Netherlands flag patterns have been added to the game.

Other developments
Fixed an issue where plug-in icons were not visible in the AWP dimension pattern.
Fixed the disappearance of the Service Building on the Battle Royale map.
Added Bomb, Knife, Weapon, Glove and Emote Subcategories to Cards."

notes.title: Update 1.46 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31476198/b2ddc14e30c297146a474d30903c2de49ff1400d.jpg[/img]

[b]Innovations in Zula continue without slowing down! Update 1.46 is now live![/b]

1-Reflex+ and Scope+
Thanks to the newly added Reflex+ and Scope+ to Zula, players will now be able to see how many lives their opponents have left thanks to the digital screen!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31476198/a45bd23052adc593eeef6d1a3d4c2f030ca9dfe3.png[/img]

2-Submission System
You can't win every fight, sometimes you have to surrender to the opponent. Thanks to the surrender option, you can now surrender by voting in Competition matches.

3-Maintenance Mode Competitive Improvement
When the game is taken into maintenance, the matches of our players who played the Competition match will be canceled and there will be no change in their Elo scores after the cancellation.

4- Heroic Crystal Series was added to the game with the Storm Season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31476198/3c0b13973db687a625fcf768e66ca0c23e2dfe61.png[/img]

5-Crystal Gloves
The "Crystal Glove" has been added to the game, which will complete your Crystal Series combination. By the way, remember that with the 1.45 update, your Gloves can be seen by both your opponent and your teammates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31476198/4931b9302f862244267d7b58406024131adcfd23.png[/img]

6-Gold Forge Series
A new legend is born! The new Elite Series Gold Forge is live with the update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31476198/56f568fa30620bc7d0cbd05f8b89162e788a96b6.png[/img]

7-Gold Forge Gloves
Worthy of the Gold forge series, were also added to the game with the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31476198/1a306cc2d9704a9beea85307830c821174c5b9ae.png[/img]

8-Storm Season
Are you ready for a Stormy Season? Zula Pass Storm Season is now in the game with plenty of rewards!
[previewyoutube=MEe4uKPUwe8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











9-Alien S2023 Sniper
You loved Alien Weapons! Get ready to hit the target from 12 with Alien Sniper!

10-Alien K2023 Knife
The only thing the Alien Weapons lacked was that they didn't have a blade. Alien K2023 is now in the game!

11-Raptor Knife
The Raptor blade, specially designed for the season, has been added to the game!

12-New Sprays
Fun and meaningful new sprays have been added to the game.

Other improvements
-Character category has been added under the Safes tab
-The bonus system has been activated. You will be able to see the Iftar and Sahur times of the city you are in the game.
- A ridge has been added to the mosque on the Üsküdar map.
-Fixed the issue where Clan Logos would appear dark on maps.
Fixed the bug where damage and health indicators are broken after using Toxic Gas in Battle Royale.

Code can be used within 7 days and is limited[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/253e8aa2bbd343d60babfd8431671b99498aa293.jpg[/img]

[b]Version 1.42 Released![/b]

Zula continues to develop with your suggestions. We are here again with a full update this month.

Clan 2.0
We're here with the Clan 2.0 update to implement suggestions from our chats with Clan chiefs, social media, and our support system for a while.
Being a Clan member in Zula will now offer you different advantages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a2b3a27fdf64cf14ed1125f9b83aaa977e1d5f1d.jpg[/img]

Clan Market
Added "Clan Items" category, which will be added to the market with Clan 2.0 in Zula.

Clan Levels (Level)
- Clan levels increased from level 50 to level 100.
- Surprise gifts can be yours depending on your clan's level!
- All clan gifts can get gifts when clan level up.
- When your clan levels up, you can see the gift you will get in the next level.

Clan Bonuses
With Clan 2.0, special bonuses for your Clan will be with you. Also, the bonuses you earn will be multiplied with your level ups!

XP BONUS
XP bonus is given in every match up to the clan players of the relevant level.

Zp BONUS
ZP bonus equal to the clan clan level in the relevant level is given in each match.

Material BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given an end-match material bonus equal to the clan level in each match.

BONUS BONUS
End-match elo gains are increased as much as the clan level for the clan players at the relevant level. It doesn't contribute to Elo losses.

Batlle Pass Star BONUS
The stars obtained from the quests, achievements and contracts are added as + to the clan players at the relevant level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/320962604839b7b407cc8ad2c137b55c9a4cc9ca.png[/img]

Upgrade BONUS
The probability of success in upgrading clan players at the relevant level is increased by the clan level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/4c0fe9ecec69fdc20b331b5e37fb4eb306314988.png[/img]

6. Bonus Card BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level receive a discount equal to the clan level when they buy the 6th card in the deck expansion. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b30a89281c17febf8505736d9cf4a5fc1264a3b6.png[/img]

Jeton Market Renewal BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level receive a discount equal to the clan level in coin market renewals.

Card Refund BONUS
Clan level discounts are applied for card refund transactions to clan players at the relevant level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b2650e59d90eb34d80c33c6a84d448c2d05eb5e7.png[/img]

Season Token BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given clan level season tokens in fast lobby tdm matches.

Competitive Token BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given clan level season tokens in fast lobby competition matches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/0a7663ad6a479a086fdc2a4c6c7e4af26f5d845d.png[/img]

BR Token BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given clan level season tokens in fast lobby battle royale matches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/69937453efb83407311f3250a2601ee90f38cf9e.png[/img]

Football Mode Now Available on Regular Servers!
You said you want to play Football Mode with our friends to the fullest, so we brought it to the regular servers special for Football Season! Let the shot you hit be the goal!

Groza Nerf
For players who call that Groza a nerf, Groza's deflection rate has been increased when the scope is closed and open. Groza lovers should not be upset, the Groza is still a very good assault rifle.

Football Season
As you know, we couldn't participate in the world cup this year. We wanted to bring this excitement to Zula. Football Season is now in Zula with its full content and only seasonal advantages!

Season Cases
When the new season comes, won't the Cashier come? Seasonal Cases are now in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/bfa944e07a5cf12777c60ef367b253877270d819.png[/img]

Orange Terminator
The Epic "Orange Terminator" exclusive to Football Season is now in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/7f57b1a309fe488d46f7e5003d57406edbc11fde.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/5772647763f32b4010ea42034c795a3dd409274f.png[/img]

Goal keeper's glove
Special Goalkeeper glove for the Football Season has taken its place in the new season!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b3932c60361f38d3a07ec5c80cdf39a1281e0d38.png[/img]

Football Sprays
Fun Sprays special for Football Season are waiting for you now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/82e90bf3f66340995608a42abea77204edac2a0a.png[/img]

Zeynep and Elena animated keychain
Animated keychains of your favorite Zeynep and Elena characters are waiting for you only in "Sezon Market"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/bdf60b6291be1a56cfea186d4326f43e09b851c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/662201e0a122761d51e437b0261905903dfd7be6.png[/img]

The "Dragon" knife, prepared with Far Eastern lines, is only on sale in the Season Market!

Improvement, bug fix

notes.title: Zula Europe Masters!
notes.content:
Zula Europe Masters is coming!


After a long time, we are with you again! The countdown has begun for the Zula Europe Masters.


The Zula Europe Masters kicks off October 2-3 as we have everyone competing for 2 Million Zula Gold across the EU region.


In the organization where a total of 16 teams from the European region will compete for the 2,000,000 Zula Gold award, competitive and entertaining matches will be waiting for us.

[url=https://forms.gle/gpk2oMLHa23begj66]Sign-ups.[/url]
 

Zula Europe Masters 2021


1. DESCRIPTON


1.1. The Zula Europe Masters is a series of tournaments organized by Lokum Games. This
rule list is the official rule list of the Zula Europe Masters. All teams and players applying to
the Zula Europe Masters declare that they have read and accepted this list of rules.
 

1.2. Validity Period
The Zula Europe Masters Rule List remains valid during the period dec the start and end of
the relevant tournament at the Zula Europe Masters. The elimination or disqualification of a
team or player from the tournament does not affect the binding of the Zula Europe Masters
Rule List.
 

2. RULES
 

2.1. Communication
The official communication channel of Zula Espor is e-mail. In order not to miss important
announcements about the Zula Europe Masters, the e-mail address specified during the
application should be up-to-date. Team officials espor@lokumgames.com he should
regularly check the emails that will come from his address.
 

2.2. Privacy
The content of correspondence and conversations that take place dec any platform between
tournament managers and participants is considered confidential. It is forbidden to share
these correspondence and conversations without the written permission of Lokum Games.
Criminal proceedings may be applied and civil proceedings may be initiated against
participants who publish relevant correspondence without permission.
 

2.3. Information Sharing
Participants participating in the Zula Europe Masters are obliged to share information with
Lokum Games, including, but not limited to, first name, last name, date of birth and contact
information, if requested by tournament managers.
 

3. PARTICIPANTS
 

3.1. Number of Team Players
Each team must have at least 5 players participating in the tournament. In addition to these
players, 1 reserve player can also be registered. During the registration period of the
tournament, each player can register with only one team. The same players cannot register
with more than one team.
 

3.2. Character Names of the Players
When applying for the Zula Europe Masters, make sure that all players ' character names
are spelled correctly. Tournament tickets are sent automatically by the system, and the team
is responsible for tournament tickets that cannot be sent to incorrectly typed character
names. It is forbidden to make any changes to the character names of the players after the
start of the tournament.
 

3.3. Player Accounts
Each player must continue until the end of the tournament with the player account he has
registered for the tournament. It is forbidden to use a different account during the tournament
through a character name change or to include a player who is not included in the
tournament roster in the team.
 

3.4.1. External Applications
It is strictly forbidden to use external applications that give users an advantage, such as
macros, wall tricks, changing textures, aim bots. It is forbidden to play with game graphics
and texture using video card drivers. It is forbidden to change game files, modify the game
using external graphics programs.
 

3.4.2. Game Errors
Any intentional use of any game deficit or error may result in a penalty. It is up to the referee
to decide whether the use of the specified error significantly affects the game, whether the
round will be awarded to the team, whether the match will end or be repeated in favor of the
opposing team. In larger cases, the penalty for using game errors may be disqualification.
 

3.4.3. The Use of Cheating
Upon detection of cheating by any player, the tournament management conducts technical
investigations into which matches or for which purposes the cheat is used. As a result of
research on how the trick is used, the tournament management team can be directly
disqualified from the league, only the player can be disqualified, or Lokum Game Publishing
and Marketing A.Sh. penalties may be imposed as appropriate.
 

3.4.4 MOSS (Anti-Cheat)
MOSS: Monitor System Status is mandatory for ALL players and can be found
under: https://nohope.eu. Players must use the program for the full duration of all
matches. If a Player cannot use MOSS he is not allowed to participate in a match
and can grant a loss even if the Team wins. For a missing or an incomplete MOSS
file the player/team will be punished. Player can be punished by Zula Gold or game
suspension. Team can be punished too by Zula Gold or default win.
 

3.5. Team Manager
Each team must have a team manager. In the absence of a team manager, the team captain
will be considered a team manager. The tournament management will inform you about such
issues as support, appeals, transfers, prizes only to the e-mail address and phone number
specified at the time of application.
 

4. TOURNAMENT PROCESS
 

4.1. Teams
The Zula Europe Masters takes place with the participation of a maximum of 16 teams, the
prize pool may change depending on the number of participants.
 

4.2. Matches
During the tournament, no power balance is observed when determining the fixtures,
matches and match schedule are determined randomly.
 

4.3. Tournament Format
All matches, including the finals at the Zula Europe Masters, will be played as BO3
according to the single-elimination procedure. In the matches played as BO3, the team that
wins two matches against its opponent will advance to the top round.
 

4.3.1. Match Rules
In the Zula Competition Tournament, matches are played in a Sabotage type with teams of 5
people. Matches will be played until the quarterfinals with the condition that the field wins 2
minutes 15 seconds/5 rounds, and after the quarterfinals with the condition that the field wins
2 minutes 15 seconds/10 rounds.
 

4.4. Match Schedule
October 2-3 All matches at the Zula Europe Masters are played between Dec. Lokum
Games reserves the right to make changes to match dates and times with prior notice.
 

4.5. Tournament Server
All matches at the Zula Europe Masters are played on the Tournament Server. If the Referee
/ Supervisor thinks that it would be inappropriate to play the match on the Tournament
Server, he / she may decide that the match should be played on a different server. In order
to avoid possible disruptions, all players should wait at the Tournament Server ready for half
an hour before match time.
 

4.6. Map Pool
Refugee Camp, Favela, Old Town, Wedding Hall, Chinese Gardens, Castle, Mardin.
 

4.7. Selection of Maps and Parties
There will be no map selection until the quarter-final stage of the Zula Europe Masters, and
all matches will be played on the maps of Safranbolu, Favela, Chinese Gardens,
respectively. In the announced match schedule, the team whose name is on the left will start
the match on the ZULA side, the team whose name is on the right will start the match on the
GLADIO side.
 

4.8.1. Quarterfinals, Semifinals and Final
Starting from the quarter-final stage (including the finals), the map selection will take place
as follows:
 

B Team 1. Map BAN
A Team 2. Map BAN
B Team 3. Map BAN
A Team 4. Map BAN
A Team 1. Map and Side PICK
B Team 2. Map and Side PICK
Team A is 3rd. Map and Side PICK
 

4.9. Start of The Tournament Match
All matches at the Zula Europe Masters begin at the specified match time. Teams that are
not ready as 5 people in the room at the specified match time are disqualified from the
tournament.
 

4.10. Technical Problems with the Player
After a match starts at the Zula Europe Masters, the match continues even if there are drops
from the game. If a team falls to 2 people during a match, the relevant team is considered to
have lost the match that is currently in progress.
 

4.11. Cast Changes
At the Zula Europe Masters, each team must continue that match with the squad that started
the match. Even if there are drops from the game after the match starts, the reserve player
cannot be included in the match, only players who have fallen out of the game can be
connected to the match again. A change of player is made only on the sidelines of dec
match. The reserve player of the changing team who enters the room during the match will
be kicked out of the room.
 

4.12. Registration of the Match Score
Team captains must take a screenshot at the end of the match that clearly and clearly shows
the result of the match. If requested by the tournament management, the team is obliged to
send this screenshot to Lokum Games. In cases where the match score cannot be
registered with the screenshot, both teams may be disqualified from the tournament.

notes.title: Update Notes - 18 August
notes.content:
In this update, we have discussed our work on new reticle customization settings, increasing the bullet bounce rate in the sniper, and a fix for the lag / teleportation issue.

[list]
[*] [b]Crosshair customization;[/b]
[/list]
You can choose three different reticles, individually customizable, copy and save your Sight code so you don't lose it, or share your reticle with your friends.

[b]Classic Crosshair:[/b]
After choosing the classic reticle, you can customize it like behavior, midpoint, outline, color from the section below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/1729e8edc26917ff20817c18cd2e256ae0527269.png[/img]

[b]The modern Crosshair:[/b]
After choosing the modern reticle, you can customize the stability, response, color and spacing from the section below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/52de546af6cad9eae65ee7d48ae5dfa790710ec0.jpg[/img]

[b]Point Crosshair:[/b]
You can customize the response, color and width of the dot sight according to your playstyle and start using it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/984b41e94968c1393b23cb618035158640505af9.jpg[/img]

[b]Crosshair code and sharing with your friends:[/b]
After customizing your crosshair, you can share the code in the "Crosshair Code" section below with your friends by clicking the "Copy" button.

[b]How can you use the code your friend sent you?[/b]
After copying the code, you can click the 'Paste' button to start using the reticle your friend has customized.


[list]
[*] [b]Increasing the ricochet rate in sniper guns;[/b]
[/list]
Before, it was easier to kill your enemy with a jumping sniper. We've increased the bounce rate of the weapon to make it a bit more difficult and to make the game even more balanced.

[list]
[*] [b]Lag / teleport fixed;[/b]
[/list]
As soon as your internet is gone during the match, the system will instantly detect that the player's internet is gone and will give a notification to the screen.
If there is no internet connection for 10 seconds during the matches, the player will be suspended from the match. If this happens in a Battle Royale match, the player's suspension from the match is set to 20 seconds.

With this improvement, we've done our best to block players who cheat teleports and offer a more enjoyable match for you.

Enjoy!
